Messages.Author: Mark Philip Molina
Messages.Body:
In some combat cards with Thaumaturgy as the required ability, such as Drain 
Essence, it will have a phrase like "Strike: ranged. Steal 2 blood. Not usable
first round." (Example from Drain Essence) Does this mean the strike must be
from a long range, or can it be from close as well?

Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:
Before I could do anything to stop it, Mark Philip Molina wrote:

> In some combat cards with Thaumaturgy as the required ability, such as Drain 
> Essence, it will have a phrase like "Strike: ranged. Steal 2 blood. Not usable
> first round." (Example from Drain Essence) Does this mean the strike must be
> from a long range, or can it be from close as well?

Ranged damage can be dealt from close or long range. I think that the 
reason they described it this way is because Steal Blood cannot be 
prevented by damage reduction cards like regular and aggravated damage 
can. This text lets you know that you can steal blood even if you 
maneuver to range.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
By default, all ranged ("R") damage may be used even if the round is
at close range.  A lot of cards will say "only usable at long range",
but Drain Essence isn't one of them.
